scope: All 143 zh-TW narration lines against EN/JA translations; six chapters, title, description, tags and three thumbnail text fields per locale; claims and worksheet glossary/boundaries. Text semantics/preparation only.
limitations: No audio, timeline or SRT exists for this remake. Cue clause order was checked against worksheet boundaries only.
Actual caption segmentation, reading speed, synchronization, pronunciation, dubbing fit, media QA, final video and owner approval are unverified.
Soft line-length guidance was not used to drop clauses or fail otherwise faithful text. No max_chars budgets were supplied.

fixes.problem: 發行人 here is the listing issuer/company. Publisher changes the attributed party to a book publisher.
fixes.current: In the publisher's vision, buyers took on the author's role along with the notebook.
fixes.suggested: In the company's vision, buyers took on the author's role along with the notebook.

fixes.problem: The worksheet places the invitation to subscribe at the end of the second cue. Subscribe has moved ahead of both topic clauses. Retain their order for later cue preparation.

fixes.suggested: To keep exploring how names on everyday things become businesses, and the practical tests they face, subscribe.

verified_constraints: All dates, numerical amounts and percentage comparisons match zh-TW.
Listing market capitalization is distinguished from revenue; share valuation is distinguished from cash paid into the company.
1997-11-26 remains first trademark filing; the historical writers did not use the later modern brand.
2013 contracts are historical, and 3–6 months remains production-to-launch rather than manufacturing time.
79 stores is year-end 2016; fiscal-2025 impairment is not retimed to 2026 publication.
2026 H1 comparisons remain half-year-on-half-year, and only part of shareholder-loan principal is waived.
Narrator opinions and company/source attributions remain explicit apart from the issuer fix listed above.
Moleskine, Modo&Modo and D’Ieteren retain their Latin brand/company forms.
Thumbnail has all three nonempty fields; meaning, amounts and source formatting are retained.
